findings.title: Security header not set: Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: The HTTP header Content-Security-Policy was absent on 6/6 HTML pages crawled. Helps prevent XSS and data-injection by constraining where content can load from. This is a defense-in-depth gap, not a directly exploitable vulnerability.

evidence.description: Content-Security-Policy absent on 6/6 HTML pages of crawled HTML pages
evidence.response_summary: example: GET http://127.0.0.1:5001/ — header not present

findings.remediation: Set the recommended headers at the application or reverse-proxy layer. Prioritize Content-Security-Policy and Strict-Transport-Security on authentication and payment surfaces.
findings.simple_summary: The site does not send the 'Content-Security-Policy' protection header.
findings.why_it_matters: Browsers get less guidance on how to safely handle the site, which makes some other attacks easier to perform.

findings.title: Security header not set: Strict-Transport-Security
